summary: Open-source AI RSS reader that gathers blogs, news, podcasts and social feeds in one timeline, with AI summaries and translation.

heroCommands.command: Open app.folo.is in your browser, or install Folo for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows or Linux

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Folo is an open-source AI RSS reader. It brings blogs, news sites, newsletters, podcasts, video channels and social feeds into one calm timeline, lets you ask AI about what you read, gives you a digest of your day, and offers summaries and translations.
sixtySeconds.problem: Following many sources means many apps and too much to read. Folo combines them in one place and uses AI to help you get through it.
whoFor: Heavy readers of blogs and news
People who follow many creators across platforms
Readers of content in other languages
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an open-source reader that syncs across web, mobile and desktop, with AI chat, timeline summaries and translation built in.
requirements: A browser, or the app for your device

overview: Folo runs in the browser and on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux, and keeps subscriptions, read status and stars in sync.

AI features include asking about an article, a feed, a folder or everything you follow, choosing your model or bringing your own API key, connecting MCP services, timeline summaries, and side-by-side translation in English, Chinese, Japanese or French.
Community packages exist for Arch (AUR), Flatpak, Nix, Homebrew (brew install --cask folo) and Scoop. Folo is AGPL-3.0 licensed.
